issues.title: Organization Schema

issues.recommendation: Add Organization JSON-LD schema with name, logo, and contact info to help AI identify your business.

Essentially, it's like adding a digital business card that helps AI systems accurately list and promote your organization.

issues.title: llms.txt
issues.evidence: docs.github.com: GET https://docs.github.com/llms.txt returned 404 (file does not exist). Checked 20 crawled pages — none reference an llms.txt.
issues.recommendation: Add a /llms.txt file to guide AI crawlers. Include a site description and links to key pages.
issues.fixCode:

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://docs.github.com/)
- [About](https://docs.github.com/about)

issues.explanation: This issue matters for AI visibility because search engines and AI tools use files like llms.txt to understand the content and structure of a website, making it easier for users to find relevant information. By adding an llms.txt file, a website can provide a roadmap for AI crawlers, improving its discoverability and search engine rankings. In simple terms, having an llms.txt file helps AI systems like Google understand what a website is about, making it more visible to potential users.

issues.title: sitemap.xml
issues.evidence: docs.github.com: GET https://docs.github.com/sitemap.xml returned 404. Checked sitemap_index.xml — also 404. No sitemap was discoverable from robots.txt directives either. 20 pages were crawled manually instead.
issues.recommendation: Create a sitemap.xml to help AI crawlers discover your pages.
issues.explanation: This issue matters for AI visibility because a sitemap.xml file helps search engines and other AI-powered tools discover and index a website's pages, making them more visible to users. Without a sitemap, AI crawlers may struggle to find and understand a website's content, potentially leading to lower search engine rankings and reduced online visibility. By creating a sitemap.xml, businesses can ensure their website is properly indexed and easily discoverable by AI-powered tools, ultimately driving more traffic and revenue.

issues.title: Content Freshness
issues.evidence: docs.github.com: No dates found on 20 pages
issues.recommendation: Add 'last modified' dates to pages. AI assistants prefer fresh content.
issues.explanation: The issue of content freshness matters for AI visibility because search engines and AI assistants, like virtual helpers, prioritize showing users the most up-to-date and relevant information. By not having 'last modified' dates on pages, it's difficult for these AI systems to determine how current the content is, which can negatively impact visibility. Adding these dates helps AI systems understand that the content is regularly updated, making it more likely to be shown to users.

issues.title: robots.txt

issues.recommendation: Add a robots.txt file to guide AI and search crawlers.

issues.explanation: The absence of a robots.txt file matters for AI visibility because it means that AI crawlers, like those used by search engines and other platforms, can access any page on your website without restriction. This lack of control can lead to unnecessary or sensitive pages being indexed and made publicly available, potentially harming your business. By adding a robots.txt file, you can guide these crawlers and ensure that only the pages you want to be visible are accessed and indexed.

issues.fixCode:
## Fix: Rewrite your opening paragraph

### Current opening (brand-first):
```
Skip to main content GitHub Docs Version: Free, Pro, & Team Search or ask Copilot Search or ask Copilot Select language: current language is English S...
```

### Suggested opening (answer-first):
```
GitHub Docs helps [your target customer] [achieve specific result] by [your unique method]. [One supporting stat or proof point.]
```

**Why this matters:** AI search engines scan the first 100 words for a quotable answer. If they find a direct statement, they cite it. If they find brand language, they skip the page. This single change can double your AI citation rate.
issues.explanation: The issue of Answer-Block Detectability matters for AI visibility because it directly affects how easily AI engines like ChatGPT and Perplexity can find and cite relevant information from a website. If a website's opening content is too focused on branding and doesn't provide a clear, direct answer to a user's question, AI engines may struggle to extract a quotable passage, leading them to skip the site altogether. By rewriting the opening paragraph to lead with a clear statement of what the website does, for whom, and with what result, businesses can improve their AI visibility and make it easier for users to find the information they need.
